## What's Changed

- Adds an opt-in full local-discovery response for Tater Tube Player collection screens.
- Keeps the existing 200-title discovery limit for original players and other clients.
- Leaves lightweight home and library shelf previews unchanged.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

No configuration migration is required.
